The '''Valderic languages''' are the language family associated with [[Imperial Rhovland]] and several Rhovlandian regional languages.

Current local drafts include [[Witersckar]], [[Geslariena]], and [[Rontzken]] as Valderic-family languages. The source material uses branch labels such as West Valderic, East Valderic, High Valderic, Riverine Valderic, and Mountain Valderic, but does not yet provide a complete family tree.

== Draft Scope ==

This page exists to connect Rhovland's language pages without inventing a full linguistic chronology. It should be expanded only after source review settles the relationship between Witersckar's federal standard, Geslariena's riverine tradition, and Rontzken's mountain/mining tradition.
